Messages in this chat are sent to Google Gemini to generate replies. AI can make mistakes.

When you use an AI feature, only what that feature needs is sent to Google Gemini: your prompt or draft, the chat messages you ask it to summarize or scan for tasks (with sender names), or the voice message you ask it to transcribe. Nothing is sent automatically, suggestions are never acted on without your confirmation, and AI output is always labelled. You can withdraw consent in Settings › AI features.
